summary: Well-structured test suite covering main requirements with solid unit tests for core logic (parseVersion, determineBumpType, bumpVersion), integration tests for the full CLI workflow, and validation of GitHub Actions structure. Tests thoroughly cover the three main version bump types (major/minor/patch) and key error scenarios. Act harness validates workflow execution via Docker. Gaps: generateChangelogEntry is tested only with a single mixed case—no tests for edge cases like only-features, only-fixes, only-breaking. Only 3 act test cases (all happy path, no error scenarios). Some functions tested only implicitly (formatVersion, parseCommitLog). Missing edge cases in error handling (invalid JSON in version file, very large version numbers). Fixtures (version.json, commits-*.txt) are referenced but not shown. Would catch regressions in core version-bumping logic and workflow structure; might miss edge cases in changelog generation or unusual input combinations.
